_doc: Voices for the extra story languages (fr de ja es pt), read by tools/story/voice_i18n.py. Every role is a Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign voice: `design` says who is speaking, in English, without any accent words (the script adds 'native <language> speaker'). Lookup order for a role: stories.<story>.<role>, then the role's English design in tools/story/cast_<story>.json (accent sentences stripped), then roles.<role>, then roles._crowd for crowd roles. `fx` names a voice.py FX chain (plain, warm, nasal, offstage, field). Arabic has no voice: Qwen3-TTS has no Arabic (talker_config.codec_language_id of the model, checked 2026-11-22), so Arabic plays with subtitles only.

accent.fr: A native French speaker with clear, standard French pronunciation.
accent.de: A native German speaker with clear, standard German pronunciation.
accent.ja: A native Japanese speaker with clear, standard Japanese pronunciation.
accent.es: A native Spanish speaker with clear, neutral Latin American Spanish pronunciation.
accent.pt: A native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with clear, standard Brazilian pronunciation.

narrator.design: A warm female storyteller in her thirties reading a picture book aloud to a six-year-old: gentle, bright, clear, unhurried, smiling, a little mysterious at the exciting parts.

_crowd.design: A cheerful man in his thirties calling out loudly as one voice in an excited crowd, energetic and lively.

king.design: Male, about sixty, a mighty old king who is kind at heart: a deep, warm, slightly worried baritone, slow and royal.

daniel.design: Male, about thirty-five, a warm, calm, gentle baritone, soft and clean with a little resonance, unhurried, kind and dependable like a gentle big brother.

officer.design: Male, about forty, a tall thin court official: a thin, nasal, whiny tenor, sly and sarcastic, always complaining, like a comic little villain in a children's cartoon.

king.design: Male, about forty, a grand Persian king: a rich, deep, warm baritone, proud and royal but kind.

haman.design: Male, about forty-five, a comic cartoon villain in a children's radio play: pompous, vain and cowardly, a nasal voice with big exaggerated pitch swings.

mordecai.design: Male, about sixty, a wise, calm old man with a low, steady, kind voice.

esther.design: Female, about twenty, a young queen: a clear, sweet, warm voice, brave and sincere, gently spoken.

miriam.design: Female, about thirty, a big sister: a bright, crisp, warm and lively voice, quick and energetic.

god.design: Male, middle-aged, a low, full, warm voice, very calm and unhurried, loving and weighty like a kind father, never shouting.

jonah.design: Male, about thirty-five, a mild, slightly stubborn middle voice, neither rough nor sharp, plain and sincere, like an ordinary, rather obstinate man.

son.design: Male, about twenty, a big boy: a young, bright, clear voice, medium-high, light and nimble, a bit cheeky, very expressive.

brother.design: Male, about twenty-eight, a big farm worker: a low, heavy, slightly rough voice, sulky, slow and stiff, always grumbling.

ruth.design: Female, about twenty-five, a young widow: a soft, clear, gentle and loyal voice, warm and sincere.

boaz.design: Male, about fifty, a kind, generous landowner: a warm, steady, friendly baritone.

david.design: A boy of about twelve, a young shepherd: a clear, light, bright boyish voice, brave and cheerful.

goliath.design: Male, a huge cartoon giant: an extremely deep, booming, rumbling bass, slow and boastful, scary in a funny way for children.

saul.design: Male, about fifty-five, an older king, kind but worried: a low, tired, gentle voice.

soldiers.design: A young soldier in his twenties shouting loudly in a battle cry, excited, as one voice of many.
